name: 92117 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92117 (San Diego) has 165 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92117 (San Diego) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92117 (San Diego) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
